ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixels with high-intensity white pixels localized in small clusters, covering approximately <5% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigmentation across most contiguous areas. Distinct high-intensity white cluster at the far left distal tip. Multiple high-contrast annular (ring-shaped) clusters localized on the upper right and center-left lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged irregularity and tissue deformation on the far left distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and annular high-contrast white pixel clusters; a cluster of three rings on the upper right lobe and several scattered rings on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, faint, unaligned linear white pixel markings detected primarily on the upper mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jagged deformation at the far left distal tip; multiple circular scars consistent with barnacle attachment marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique spatial distribution of annular (ring-shaped) scars across both fluke lobes.
